items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:71:1
items.html: But the VAK of Bina of MA, together with the Malchut of Bina of MA, which are YESHSUT, resemble ZON and are not joined together in as great a union as AVI: because there is a great difference between the upper AVI, who are from the Chazeh [chest] and above of AA, and YESHSUT, who are from the Chazeh and below of AA, as above in the adjacent item; study it there well. Hence the MA and BON within them are not joined together so much, as above in the ARI’s words (page 663, item 65), that the more the Partzufim go down from their degree, the more their separation of MA from BON is revealed within them; see there in the Inner Light. And it has already been explained above that YESHSUT resemble ZON, in that they are the discernment of AHP that went outside the Rosh, together with ZON; study it there well.
